# Integration Test Suite for Order Fulfillment System

```python
import pytest
from testcontainers.compose import DockerCompose
from unittest.mock import AsyncMock, patch
import asyncio
from uuid import uuid4

# === FIXTURES ===

@pytest.fixture(scope="session")
def services():
    """Spin up all microservices via docker-compose."""
    with DockerCompose(".", compose_file_name="docker-compose.test.yml") as compose:
        compose.wait_for("http://localhost:8001/health")  # Order
        compose.wait_for("http://localhost:8002/health")  # Inventory
        compose.wait_for("http://localhost:8003/health")  # Payment
        compose.wait_for("http://localhost:8004/health")  # Notification
        yield compose

@pytest.fixture
def test_order():
    """Isolated test data with unique ID."""
    return {
        "order_id": str(uuid4()),
        "items": [{"sku": "TEST-001", "qty": 2}],
        "customer_id": "test-customer",
        "payment_method": "test-card"
    }

@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
async def cleanup(test_order):
    """Cleanup after each test."""
    yield
    await reset_inventory(test_order["items"])
    await cancel_pending_orders(test_order["order_id"])

# === HAPPY PATH ===

@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_complete_order_flow(services, test_order):
    """Full order succeeds: inventory reserved, payment processed, notification sent."""
    result = await submit_order(test_order)
    
    assert result["status"] == "confirmed"
    assert await inventory_reserved(test_order["items"])
    assert await payment_captured(test_order["order_id"])
    assert await notification_sent(test_order["customer_id"], "order_confirmed")

# === SERVICE FAILURE SCENARIOS ===

@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_inventory_insufficient_cancels_order(services, test_order):
    """Order fails when inventory unavailable - no payment attempted."""
    await deplete_inventory("TEST-001")
    
    result = await submit_order(test_order)
    
    assert result["status"] == "failed"
    assert result["reason"] == "insufficient_inventory"
    assert not await payment_attempted(test_order["order_id"])

@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_payment_failure_unreserves_inventory(services, test_order):
    """Payment failure triggers inventory compensation."""
    with patch_payment_to_fail():
        result = await submit_order(test_order)
    
    assert result["status"] == "failed"
    assert await inventory_released(test_order["items"])  # Compensating tx

@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_notification_failure_does_not_rollback(services, test_order):
    """Notification failure doesn't affect order - eventual consistency."""
    with patch_notification_to_fail():
        result = await submit_order(test_order)
    
    assert result["status"] == "confirmed"  # Order still valid
    assert await notification_queued_for_retry(test_order["order_id"])

# === TIMEOUT & RETRY ===

@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_inventory_timeout_retries_then_fails(services, test_order):
    """Inventory service timeout triggers 3 retries before failure."""
    with patch_inventory_latency(seconds=10):
        result = await submit_order(test_order, timeout=2)
    
    assert result["status"] == "failed"
    assert await inventory_call_count(test_order["order_id"]) == 3

# === ASYNC MESSAGE HANDLING ===

@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_out_of_order_messages_handled(services, test_order):
    """System handles payment confirmation arriving before inventory ack."""
    await publish_event("payment.captured", test_order["order_id"])
    await asyncio.sleep(0.1)
    await publish_event("inventory.reserved", test_order["order_id"])
    
    assert await order_eventually_confirmed(test_order["order_id"], timeout=5)

# === COMPENSATING TRANSACTIONS ===

@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_partial_failure_full_rollback(services, test_order):
    """Mid-flow failure rolls back all completed steps."""
    with patch_payment_to_fail_after_capture():
        result = await submit_order(test_order)
    
    assert await refund_issued(test_order["order_id"])
    assert await inventory_released(test_order["items"])
```

**Key design decisions:**
- **Testcontainers** for real service instances, avoiding mock drift
- **UUID-based isolation** prevents test interference
- **Autouse cleanup fixture** ensures consistent state
- **Targeted patches** simulate specific failure modes
- **Eventual consistency assertions** with timeouts for async flows
